horoscope: Today is suitable for creative thinking and putting your unique perspective and viewpoint to good use, dear Aries. Challenges to your thinking can lead to interesting mental detours. The Moon spends the day in your solar eleventh house, and you’re inclined to think about what or who makes you happy and set ambitions aside for a spell. Dedication to a friend or project can be rewarding and natural now. You’re in a fraternizing frame of mind. The Moon here can stimulate a need to let go of pressures and unwind in good company. A stronger drive to grow, try something different or alternative, and to connect with others or connect with a dream or goal is with you today.

Today is good for thinking outside the box, especially about financial and practical matters, dear Taurus. Analyzing past patterns can help you make better decisions. If you approach any problems that arise as stimulating challenges, you’re in the right mindset to overcome them and learn from the process. You’re thinking in bigger terms than usual, making it an excellent time to clarify your goals. Indeed, your responsibilities and reputation are special concerns with the Moon at the top of your solar chart all day. You’re getting noticed, and it’s your performance, past or present, that receives the most attention now. This can prompt you to check in with the rules or your own goals, motivating you to push a little more, up your game, and do your best.

You can be excited about a longer-term plan, project, or group endeavor today, dear Gemini. You can feel quite inspired by something shared with a friend or in your network. Inventive new ideas, dreams, and possibilities can figure strongly now. Your enthusiasm runs high. The broader issues that concern you come into play, with the Moon in your spirit sector. Seeing the bigger picture soothes and comforts you right now. This Moon intensifies your desire for forward movement, growth, and discovery.

You could find yourself seeking inspiration today, dear Cancer. You may feel a sense of creative renewal or liberation and be tempted to break through taboos or force changes. There is good energy for creative and innovative thinking about business or long-term goals. You might surprise yourself by divulging information that you didn’t think you’d reveal. Perhaps a mischievous part of you wants to put something from the past behind you. The Moon spends the day in your intimacy sector, which can feel like a strong call to specialize or focus your energies.

Strong energy is with you today and tomorrow for opportunities to learn and heal, dear Leo. You might aim to take on a reasonable challenge to more thoroughly enjoy the extra dose of enthusiasm the day supplies. You can be holding on to your ideas and going your own way with them, expecting others to accept you for who you are. Still, you seem to need others or seek feedback more so than usual with the Moon’s all-day transit of your partnership sector, and you can feel a little torn as a result. The desire for another perspective on a situation is strong. Try not to stress over roadblocks. While you may not always agree with others today, you’re likely to learn a lot from your interactions. You're especially interested in finding a balance or keeping the peace.

Work or business can do particularly well if you apply nontraditional thinking to them these days, dear Virgo. The desire to innovate is strong. You can find it quite natural to connect with your dreams and ideals today, even with the Moon’s all-day transit of your work and health sector. Getting chores out of the way or clearing up paperwork can help clear your head and make room for the more exciting or creative endeavors you want to pursue. Analyzing patterns, particularly related to business and finances, can help you think up new, improved methods. Problems do seem to stick out more than usual, but you're ready to handle them. It's a potentially highly productive time.

Today, an idea can inspire you and set off interesting tangents of thought, dear Libra, or it might lead you down a new path. You’re seeking a boost to your spirits. This week emphasizes new and even breakthrough thinking, and there can be unexpected benefits coming through a faraway connection or partnership. Today’s Moon encourages finding some time for personal enjoyment. You’re likely to discover some especially inventive or positive ideas and attitudes through your interactions.

Today’s energies challenge you to let go of familiar patterns of thinking and create new ones, dear Scorpio. Even if you disagree with others on some points, you’re certainly finding things to stimulate your mind. This is a fine time for research, work, and health matters, in particular. Problem-solving is a theme now, as you’re seeing patterns that you may not typically notice on a busier day. Mechanical and mental work can thrive, and communications tend to be powerful. Still, the Moon spends the day in your sector of heart and home, and it’s a good idea to carve out some time for quiet and comfortable activities.

You’re curious and mentally engaged today and tomorrow, dear Sagittarius, and you’re coming up with great ideas, especially when you put your head together with someone. It’s a fine time to generate ideas or solve a problem that clears the path for new directions. It's a fine time to recognize patterns and put puzzle pieces together, although this is likely to come after some trial and error. Bouncing ideas off someone else can help a lot, and so can putting pen to paper or typing your ideas out. Verbalizing in these ways can lead to better decision-making today. You might discover information or solve a problem that clears the path for new beginnings. The Moon spends the day in your communications sector, and this can ideally turn your attention to a variety of interesting things.

The day is strong for stretching your thinking and being better off for it, dear Capricorn. You recognize patterns, and this process helps make decision-making more natural. You could feel freer in self-expression and a little more courageous on a mental level, even with the Moon in your practical second house. You are going your own way with your ideas about how to best approach your work, wellness, duties, and routines. Still, with the Moon in your resources sector, you’re seeking a nice dose of emotional predictability, and centering yourself, getting comfortable, and enjoying pleasures are appealing.

Today’s energies support creative expression, dear Aquarius. Seeing past patterns can help bring perspective to your projects and endeavors. The Moon in your sign today can make everything feel a little more urgent than it actually is, but as the day advances, it becomes more natural to enjoy yourself rather than focus on frustrations. You tend to command positive attention. While self-directed activities fare the best today, you’re gaining others’ cooperation easily. A healthy balance of optimism and caution means the efforts and plans you make now tend to hold weight down the road.

There can be an illuminating moment today, dear Pisces, and problem-solving with family, home, and money matters is especially creative. Innovative ideas are easier to come by today and tomorrow. You seem to instinctively know when to go for something and when to reel it in. However, the Moon spends the day in your solar twelfth house, and this transit points to the need for extra rest, repose, or time for reflection. It may be difficult to turn your mind off enough to rest–perhaps your mind is in overdrive now–but it’s better for you if you do! Unwinding is a natural progression of the lunar cycle as you prepare for the Moon’s entrance into your sign tomorrow. Good energy is with you for helping someone out behind the scenes.
